doc.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025

title: Upcoming gigs and plans
summary: Bennett lists his coming week of shows around Michigan and Minneapolis and plans to write songs in May.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Right. What’s your very next gig, speaking of gigs?

I’m playing Saturday, there’s a place in Brighton, Michigan called — it’s an Italian place called Ciao Amici’s. And we’re going to be doing two shows Saturday night, and that will be the full thing, you know, the jazz, the rock, the craziness. And then Monday I’ve got a private event duo performance with my piano player. Tuesday I’m guesting with the Mott Community College big band. Wednesday I’m playing at the Zehnder’s Frankenmuth Ragtime Festival and then Thursday I’m off to Minneapolis to play four days with a friend of mine, Steve Pikal, he’s a bass player and they’re bringing me in to do some things. And then the month of May is a little lighter. The last four months have been heavy travel. So I figure in May maybe I’ll try to sit down and get creative again and see what happens.
Write some songs and work on the Mozart Clarinet Concerto.
I have a funny feelings the songs actually might come before the Mozart.
